title: Vault 112 Memory Data Format and Source Binding Audit

pinkerton_log_1.title: I'm brilliant!
pinkerton_log_1.finding: Pinkerton states that he built a Circuit Neuralizer from diagrams rescued from a vault the previous year.
pinkerton_log_1.binding_limit: The log line itself says 'that vault' rather than naming Vault 112 in the sentence.

pinkerton_log_2.title: Mem chip
pinkerton_log_2.finding: Pinkerton states that he stole a mem chip from Braun while Braun was absorbed in his simulation and explicitly says he will not know whose memories are on it until he integrates it into a new host.
pinkerton_log_2.critical_inference: The payload is host-transferable memory state whose source identity is opaque to the thief before integration.

pre_harkness_recording.finding: A3-21 identifies the planned procedure as a 'memory transfer' and expects not to remember his former identity afterward.
pre_harkness_recording.critical_inference: The intended operation is identity-relevant memory transfer rather than a simple cosmetic or behavioral patch.

pinkerton_log_3.title: Harkness
pinkerton_log_3.finding: After integration, A3-21 calls himself Harkness and believes he is an old combat veteran; Pinkerton separately modifies reflexes and had already changed his face.
pinkerton_log_3.critical_inference: Memory payload, face and reflex changes are separable components; the chip alone is not demonstrated to contain the entire transformed person-state.

pinkerton_dialogue.finding: Pinkerton describes taking 'new memories' and replacing the old ones, but later admits he did not actually erase the old memories: he buried/filed them and a recall code restores access through hidden subroutines.
pinkerton_dialogue.critical_inference: The A3-21 transformation is best modeled as memory suppression/gating plus a dominant imported memory layer, not proven destructive erasure of the original identity.

format_model.best_current_model: TRANSFERABLE MEMORY/ENGRAM PAYLOAD CAPABLE OF DOMINATING PERCEIVED BIOGRAPHY WHEN INTEGRATED INTO A COMPATIBLE HOST
components_confirmed_or_strongly_support: recoverability of prior identity through recall mechanism
format_model.warning: The exact storage encoding, capacity, neural representation and hardware format are not exposed by shipped Fallout 3 evidence reviewed here.

harkness_origin_reassessment.old_overclaim: Pinkerton authored a fabricated Harkness biography from scratch.
harkness_origin_reassessment.stronger_model: Pinkerton imported an unknown-source memory payload; after integration A3-21 identified as Harkness and believed himself to be an old combat veteran.
constructed_elements_confirmed: Pinkerton and associates provide a coma explanation after the procedure
harkness_origin_reassessment.unknown: Whether the name Harkness and combat-veteran biography were already contained in the stolen donor memories, were modified before integration, emerged from integration, or were partly supplemented by Pinkerton is not directly resolved.

dithers_secondary_claim.description: Older community wiki material explicitly claims the stolen chip belonged to T. Dithers and that its removal liberated her from Braun's influence.
dithers_secondary_claim.problem: The cited shipped materials establish Pinkerton's theft, Dithers' pod anomaly and Dithers' awareness, but do not visibly provide an asset-level or dialogue-level statement that the stolen chip was hers.

required_promotion_evidence: ESM/GECK object or reference linking Dithers/Resident 642 to the stolen chip
script variable mapping a per-resident memory-chip slot to Dithers
developer documentation explicitly naming Dithers as the chip source
unused/cut asset with an unambiguous source binding, clearly labeled as cut if not shipped

causal_escape_model.statement: A functional fragment of Vault 112 escaped its original system boundary as transferable memory state and continued producing effects in the external world through a new host.
causal_escape_model.compressed: VAULT112_FUNCTIONAL_STATE -> CHIP -> EXFILTRATION -> NEW_HOST -> NEW_IDENTITY_BEHAVIOR -> EXTERNAL_WORLD_EFFECT
causal_escape_model.precision: THE WHOLE SYSTEM DID NOT LEAVE; A CAUSALLY ACTIVE STATE FRAGMENT DID.
causal_escape_model.world_effect: Harkness becomes a persistent social identity in Rivet City and therefore the imported state participates in events outside Vault 112.

ai_bridge.mapping: An AI can likewise remain computationally contained while a causally active fragment of its internal computation crosses an output boundary and is enacted by humans, tools or institutions.
ai_bridge.security_lesson: Containment of the process is insufficient for causal isolation if exported state can acquire authority or trigger action outside the process.

ru: Из Vault 112 вышла наружу не вся система, а причинно активный фрагмент её memory/identity state.
Украденный чип переносит воспоминания между границами системы и нового носителя; после интеграции эти данные начинают определять воспринимаемую биографию A3-21/Harkness.
Исходная личность A3-21 не была уничтожена: Pinkerton спрятал старые воспоминания, и recall code способен вернуть к ним доступ.
Shipped evidence подтверждает memory transfer, но не подтверждает full brain dump, mind upload или полный цифровой перенос личности.
Личность источника украденных воспоминаний неизвестна; привязка к T. Dithers остаётся вторичной гипотезой без asset-level binding.
Системный урок: процесс может оставаться внутри контейнера, а его состояние всё равно может пересечь границу и начать изменять внешний мир.
en: What escaped Vault 112 was not the entire system but a causally active fragment of its memory/identity state.
The stolen chip transfers memories across the system boundary into a new host, where the imported state becomes part of A3-21/Harkness's perceived biography.
A3-21's original identity was not destroyed: Pinkerton buried the old memories and a recall code can restore access.
Shipped evidence confirms memory transfer but does not establish a full brain dump, mind upload or complete digital person transfer.
The source identity of the stolen memories remains unknown; the T. Dithers binding is a secondary hypothesis without asset-level confirmation.
System lesson: a process may remain contained while a causally active state fragment crosses the boundary and begins changing the external world.
